name: MACH
summary: Current KUNG aero road frame with a deep head tube, dropped seatstays, T47, UDH and 32 mm tire clearance; the retailer weighed a white size-M frame at 1,150 g against a 972 g painted claim.

frame.construction: Aero tube shapes with a deep head tube under the relaxed UCI 8:1 rule, dropped seatstays, integrated cockpit routing and a KUNG aero seatpost (10 mm offset only)
frame.stiffness_evidence: A seller-published ride review describes stiffness and very direct power transfer as the frame's defining trait, with a firm but not harsh ride. No numeric or independent stiffness test is published.
frame.axles: 12 x 100 mm front, 12 x 142 mm rear
frame.claimed_frame_weight_basis: Maker claim for a painted frame; size not stated
frame.measured_frame_weight_basis: Retailer weighing of a size-M frame in white paint, which the reviewer calls the heaviest paint option

warranty_claim.note: Covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship; crashes, misuse and normal wear excluded. Mainland warranty handling through the JD flagship store is unverified.

geometry.basis: exact-model export-retailer geometry table and labelled diagram
geometry.note: Rows A–L are mapped from the retailer's labelled diagram. The listed fork offsets change by size (57.5, 51.5, then 45.5 mm) and the size-S stack/reach step is large; confirm exact fit values with the seller before ordering.

tire_clearance.note: Export-retailer specification: up to 32 mm road tires. Actual mounted width depends on tire and rim.
